verdict.rationale: Reducto's Extract citations feature is documented so that, when enabled, every extracted field includes bounding box coordinates pointing to the source text. Studio adds a citation viewer that lets humans verify values against real documents, which covers the core per-field provenance need for agents and reviewers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each citation carries a page number and the verbatim source snippet, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy (the feature is also opt-in rather than default).
